item.text:
Enabled Cache Components on Next.js 16.4.5 with partial prefetching. Product lookups now use `use cache` with the slug and currency as inputs, so the correct price can be reused across requests. The [product page](/workspace/app/products/[slug]/page.tsx) keeps the shop navigation and loading message visible, then streams product details and related products through separate Suspense boundaries.

The production build passes with `/products/[slug]` reported as a **partial prerender**, with no route opt-outs. Production requests returned the expected lamp and vase prices in USD and EUR; a repeat EUR request delivered cached product details before related products streamed in.
